analysis: The supplied change is documentation only, in docs/architecture/inference.md. The visible hunks update the CBv2 scheduler geometry table (head lines 1084-1096) and add a new 'Prompt geometry' section (lines 1101-1146). The new text describes a wider 2048/4096 prefill chunk for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and Gemma 4. It also describes a 512-token ceiling for bidirectional media blocks, and says an explicit DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK or DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS override enters the complete-checkpoint numerics fingerprint and disqualifies reviewed serving and deadline profiles. No executable code, auth, crypto or protocol surface is changed in the supplied units. I found no threat-model regression. The describing text does not loosen any prefix-cache gate relevant to T-041: TTL, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE switch are untouched. Residual points for later passes: (1) The real code changes in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (prefillGeometry, usesWidePrefillChunk, soloPrefillStripeTokens), CBv2Contracts.swift and SchedulerV2 are not in this batch. They are not verified, and the memory-admission claims rest on doc statements, such as the unchanged paged-pool maxPrefillChunk and the MoE activation peak. (2) The documented wider chunk raises the p99 inter-token gap by two to three times. That is an availability and TTFT-timing characteristic, not a new disclosure. The prefix-cache TTFT oracle (SEC-035) is accepted. (3) The patch excerpt is truncated, and the range map mentions head lines 2028-2041, which are not supplied.
